abstract.en: Seismic hazard assessment of the area of the Republic of Armenia (RA) at the scale of 1:500,000 was prepared by the Consortium of AIR Worldwide Corporation (USA), GEM Foundation (Italy) and GEORISK Scientific Research CJSC (Armenia) under the Project # 7179350 “Probabilistic Seismic Hazard Assessment for the Republic of Armenia” supported by the World Bank.
